pages.title: O gancho e a estaca
pages.scene: Adra LEFT uses ferry hook to lever the ONE loose iron spike out of already softened mud without digging or stripping living bark; Talin RIGHT holds ash staff between group and ONE root guardian. Inset shows spike coming clear, no second spike. Root organism starts settling immediately, physically coherent, same grove path.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Saiu. O ferro inteiro, sem arrancar casca.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: A raiz está soltando o caminho.

pages.title: O silêncio volta
pages.scene: Single root guardian settles back into willow roots and wet stone as same morning light returns. Sere LEFT lowers ash bow; Runa RIGHT lets the redirected stream return to its natural bed. Iron spike wrapped as evidence in Adra's hands out of frame. Five-person group intact on corridor, no victory over forest, no new magical portal.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Conte as vozes. Todos aqui?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Cinco. E a água já voltou ao leito.

pages.title: Além das raízes
pages.scene: Walking NORTH on SAME permitted ash-staked corridor AFTER guardian settles. Talin LEFT points to low timber bridges between huge roots where the forest hamlet Escada de Âmbar begins; Ilyan RIGHT sees carved waystones. Other companions close behind out of frame, none teleported. No entry into houses yet.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: A aldeia está além daquela ponte baixa.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Mira desenhou raízes assim... antes de sumir.

pages.title: Uma aldeia que vigia
pages.scene: At threshold of inhabited Escada de Âmbar forest hamlet: low timber bridges between roots, stone-and-wood homes, terraced spring stair, carved amber spiral on gate. Adult elf and gnome residents watch cautiously, not decorative fantasy crowd. Adra LEFT greets Talin RIGHT's neighbors. Other visitors remain together on bridge behind them.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Viemos com consentimento, sem exigir acesso a nada.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Eu os trouxe. A decisão de receber é de todos.

pages.title: O nome do chão
pages.scene: In same hamlet square beside amber spiral gate and stepped spring, Runa LEFT opens her field notebook while Talin RIGHT states the hamlet name should be written by its people, not assigned by school. Background homes, elven adults and short adult gnomes. The party waits for invitation, no unauthorized archive entry.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Como devo escrever o nome desta aldeia?

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Escada de Âmbar. Registre também quem o disse.

pages.title: Uma sala emprestada
pages.scene: After residents' deliberation, Talin LEFT escorts Sere RIGHT into a PUBLIC memory room in the hamlet. Fixed geography: amber spiral above south doorway, one long cedar table, two narrow WEST windows, shelves of woven book covers along north wall. Private records stay closed. Sere puts written local consent and city addendum on table.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Podem ver as cópias públicas. Os nomes de família ficam conosco.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: É o mesmo limite que exigimos da Casa.

pages.title: A medição antiga
pages.scene: Same public memory room: amber spiral south door, long cedar table, two WEST windows, north shelves. Runa LEFT opens an OLD community survey ledger with Talin's permission; Ilyan RIGHT recognizes his mother Mira's copper survey glyph in an entry dated BEFORE her disappearance two winters ago. Only glyph/mark, NO portrait of Mira. No proof she visited after vanishing.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Esta data é anterior ao desaparecimento dela.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Mas esse sinal é o que ela gravava nos meus moldes.

pages.title: O mapa não é confissão
pages.scene: At same cedar table in memory room, Ilyan LEFT studies Mira's PRE-DISAPPEARANCE public route showing the stepped spring and old bridge; Adra RIGHT points out a community correction in different ink. No supposed secret encounter. West windows and amber spiral fixed. Distinct two maps, not infinite duplicates.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ela esteve aqui. Isso eu posso afirmar.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Antes de sumir. O resto da história ainda não veio.

pages.title: A linha depois da cheia
pages.scene: Runa LEFT examines water stains along an old ledger page and a different later map line; Talin RIGHT recalls a spring flood that damaged paper. Same memory room cedar table, two west windows glowing late afternoon, woven north shelves. Runa rules out calling ordinary water damage deliberate erasure without evidence.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A mancha veio de água antiga. Não prova censura.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Nossa fonte transbordou naquele inverno.

pages.title: O preço da memória
pages.scene: In same public memory room, Sere LEFT asks to photograph? NO CAMERA. She asks permission for a HAND COPY of ONLY the public route; Talin RIGHT grants if community authorship stays on it. Sere uses quill, paper and wax, no modern device. Amber spiral south doorway and shelves fixed.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Podemos copiar só o traço público, com autoria?

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Sim. O original permanece onde nasceu.

pages.title: Degraus sob a chuva
pages.scene: Outside, the terraced spring of Escada de Âmbar below the village homes, light evening rain begins. Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT stand together under a timber awning; she sees fresh water rise above the older survey line and he holds the copied map dry. Their trust has grown through listening and shared danger; intimate but modest, no kiss or abrupt relationship.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Você ficou, mesmo quando o mapa não respondeu.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Eu quase não fiquei. Você me trouxe de volta à trilha.

pages.title: Um sinal novo
pages.scene: At SAME terraced spring next morning, Talin LEFT notices a fresh small copper survey mark on the side of a spring step, BELOW Mira's weathered older glyph. Ilyan RIGHT examines without prying or damaging stone. Fresh cut is NOT in Mira's handwriting and not proof she is alive. Rain-wet stone, amber village homes unchanged.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Esse risco novo não estava aqui na última ronda.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: O sinal dela é antigo. Alguém continuou a linha.

pages.title: A direção que falta
pages.scene: At SAME terraced spring in inhabited Escada de Âmbar, Runa LEFT overlays hand-copied old map with NEW anonymous copper mark; Adra RIGHT points to northward watercourse BEYOND their currently permitted corridor. Ilyan and Talin each ONCE in smaller background. No one steps beyond limit. Dramatic unresolved last panel of fresh mark pointing north. Mira's fate and spike setter still unknown; ARC THREE REMAINS OPEN.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A marca nova segue para o norte. Não foi feita pela mão de Mira.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: E ninguém sairá daqui antes de ouvir quem guarda aquela água.
